data.title: Greetings & Conversation — Beginner · Lesson 2
data.subject: greetings
data.lyrics:
Hey y'all… Hey y'all  
Time to meet the folks next door  
Sun's up… Sun's up  
Let's head on over, can't wait no more  

[Hook]  
Hello… Hola  
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?  
Nice to meet you… Mucho gusto  
Smile and wave… Sonríe y saluda  
Come on over, let's chat  

[Verse]  
Good morning… Buenos días  
We just moved in, it's so nice to see ya  
Very well… Muy bien  
We're settling in, can't you tell?  
Thank you… Gracias  
For the warm welcome, it means a lot  
Please… Por favor  
Come on in, let's share the spot  

[Hook]  
Hello… Hola  
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?  
Nice to meet you… Mucho gusto  
Smile and wave… Sonríe y saluda  
Neighbors now, let's hang  

[Verse]  
Need some sugar… Azúcar por favor  
We're baking up something sweet for sure  
You're welcome… De nada  
It's what neighbors do, ain't it grand?  
See you later… Hasta luego  
Gotta run, but hey, let's meet again soon, amigo  

[Bridge]  
Life's a journey… La vida es un viaje
